text: Offer heat: a hot water bottle or a warm bath often eases cramps.
Take one chore off her plate today without being asked.
Keep plans low-key and easy to cancel.
Ask what would help, then do exactly that.
Hot water bottle, snacks, and you doing the dishes. In that order.
Today's plan: whatever she says the plan is.
Be the person who appears with tea before anyone asked.
Cancel-friendly plans only. The sofa is a perfectly good destination.
Your mission: heat, snacks, silence. You are basically a very attentive radiator.
Do the dishes like someone is filming a documentary about good partners.
If in doubt, bring a blanket. If still in doubt, bring a second blanket.
Tonight you are remote-control operator, tea supplier and pillow. Promotion pending.
Her energy is often on the way up. A good week to plan something active together.
A good window for the bigger conversations you have been postponing.
Suggest something new: a walk, a trip, a project.
Say yes to her plans. Energy and focus are usually climbing.
Her energy is climbing. Yours may need a coffee to keep up.
Good week to plan that trip. Bring your calendar and your stamina.
She may have ideas. Many ideas. Nod, then book something.
Suggest something active before she suggests something more active.

Energy forecast: hers up, yours unchanged. Hydrate.
If she says "quick walk", pack snacks and tell someone where you are going.

Often the highest-energy days of her cycle. A good time for a proper date.
Plan something social. Confidence and energy tend to peak around now.
Give her your full attention this evening. Phones away.
A good moment for the plans that need her at her most energetic.
Peak-energy days. Book the table, iron the shirt.
Date night has a high chance of success. Do not suggest "whatever you want".
She is at her most sociable. Be the plus-one who planned ahead.
Put the phone down tonight. Yes, all the way down.
Peak week. Dress like you tried. Because you should try.
Tonight's forecast: she is radiant, you are underdressed. Fix one of those.
Book the nice place. The one with actual tablecloths.
Your phone can survive two hours face down. Science has confirmed this.
Listen first. A low mood is real, whatever the cause.
Reduce friction today: cook, tidy, handle the admin.
Keep her favourite comfort food in the house.
Avoid last-minute changes of plan where you can.
Today, be the calm one. And the one who cooked.
Stock the snacks before you are asked where the snacks are.
Fewer surprises, more dinner. A solid strategy this week.
Listen more than you fix. The shelf can wait; the listening cannot.
Do not, under any circumstances, ask "is it that time?". Bring chocolate and live.
Snack inventory check. If the answer is "low", you already know your mission.
This is not the week to reorganise the kitchen "to be helpful".
Your superpower this week: cooking dinner and having no opinions about the film.
